source_title: jaxer/own-your-cameras: Model-specific camera hardware research, secure owner access, firmware maintenance, and privacy-respecting local software. - GitHub
source_excerpt:
Hardware and firmware notes for selected Hikvision, Reolink and Xiaomi cameras and intercoms: root access methods, firmware-update behavior, and interfaces for custom software. Start with your model .
The aim is to keep firmware updated while retaining the ability to inspect devices and run custom software.
Disclaimer: Everything in this repository is provided for learning and information only, without warranty. Use it at your own risk. The authors accept no responsibility for damage or loss.
